step5_question.question_previous_version: Using Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what was P&G's revenue (net sales) growth rate from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026? Report the percentage rounded to one decimal place.
step5_question.gt_template:
The Revenue Growth Rate is calculated as (Revenue for 2026 - Revenue for 2025) / Revenue for 2025.

Revenue Growth Rate = ($[[Rev@FY2026]] million - $[[Rev@FY2025]] million) / $[[Rev@FY2025]] million = [[RevGrowth@FY2026|.1f]]%
